suites.title: Q26 licensing, compliance, safety, accessibility & weather

specs.title: required failures are actionable readiness blockers (derived facts), visible in feasibility, readiness and the lifecycle hook
licences: lifecycle with evidence rules; venue's verified Q08 premises licence satisfies the rule; lapse before the event blocks
expiry monitoring: the daily job expires lapsed licences and sends one reminder per threshold (idempotent)
safety plans: versioned, immutable once submitted, no self-approval for managers, approval satisfies the rule
accessibility: guest requirements drive blockers; route refs validated against the map; public summary only once approved
weather: no provider → BLOCKED_EXTERNAL shown; forecast breaches alert managers once; severe without approved contingency blocks
rule packs are data per jurisdiction: a ZZ pack applies only to ZZ events and never to GB ones
lifecycle gating (3019): compliance blockers stop publish from planning/ready, never an event that is already selling
series: occurrences come from the Q14 engine, idempotently; this / following / all keep local overrides
a season pass and single-date tickets never oversell any date, under concurrency
parent/child: integrity, readiness roll-up, lifecycle blockers and an explicit cascade
multi-venue, multi-day and multi-room bindings are enforced for every writer
forms and waivers: versioned, validated, minor consent, private signatures
stock is append-only and never negative; merchandise reserve → pay → collect → refund
lost property matches explainably and stays private; sustainability derives CO2e with provenance

suites.title: S4 organiser screens over Q23/Q40 commands

specs.title: read helpers: media problems and campaign blockers are member-only
campaign wizard: 5 steps, idempotent create, conflict, ads budget needs finance, blockers, links, blackout, report
structure: series from this event, sub-event + readiness roll-up, days, venues, pass components; cascade owner/manager only
forms & waivers: typed fields publish, versions immutable; waiver publish + attach + counts
stock & merch: append-only movements, transfer, report; merch refund/collect refusals; refund route refuses without a session
lost property: lp-v1 explainable match, claim, verify, hand over; outsiders refused
sustainability: measured entries, travel estimate split, indicative report with provenance
dependencies: add, cycle refused, hard edge blocks completion, graph + critical path, task setter, remove
approval prerequisite: members can't decide, owner decides once with a reason
brief: versioned saves, stale expected version returns a conflict (no overwrite), finance can't edit
templates: versioned family, create-from-template needs a future date, archive
lifecycle: blockers preview, transition refusal with fix links, row guard detail, role rules
W11 tiles: gala, charity and conference are organiser create-event tiles
Q42 start_agent_run mission overload: refusals only, nothing left behind
friendly refusal text for agent codes (run and approval pages)
catalogue: least-privilege grants, RLS everywhere, definer functions pinned and scoped
anonymous direct REST/RPC access is refused
another tenant cannot read or write by guessed id (tables and definer RPCs)
space conflicts reveal only 'taken' to other tenants, full detail to the venue
revoked membership loses access immediately, even to records the member created
a suspended workspace is blocked, including for its owner
owners cannot self-grant entitlements, flags or security policy through REST
feature flags evaluate server-side and never leak another tenant's override
step-up: a user with a verified factor must be on an aal2 session for sensitive actions
session revocation: a revoked session's unexpired token can no longer perform sensitive actions or refresh
seals with the active key, binds context and rotates without losing data
reports configuration honestly
